clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu of the Earthen Ring studies a spreading corruption. Horde travelers bring him a corrupted water globe recovered from Ashenvale's elementals. As a shaman devoted to elemental harmony, he seeks to understand the blight along the Zoram Strand and within Blackfathom Deeps, in hope of halting the poison in the region's waters.

Mastok Wrilehiss sends you to Je'neu Sancrea with a corrupted water globe recovered from Ashenvale's elementals. Strange elementals have surfaced across the region, animated by unnatural power that scouts cannot explain. Among their remains, the intact globe pulses with corrupted magic. Mastok knows soldiers and scouts lack the spiritual insight to understand it, so he directs Horde travelers to someone versed in ancient legends and elemental lore.

Je'neu Sancrea serves the Earthen Ring, an order of shamans devoted to balance among Azeroth's primal forces. Horde forces guard the Zoram Strand frontier while he studies the spiritual wound in Blackfathom Deeps' nearby temple ruins. To Je'neu, an elemental drawing strength from a tainted vessel is no isolated threat. It is an alarming omen: unseen, ancient powers are perverting the natural order.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Earthen Ring is a shamanistic group dedicated to studying and preserving the elements. They have forgotten more about crazy old gods, ancient legends and lore than most scholars will ever know.

Lucky for you, I know someone in the Earthen Ring here in Ashenvale. Head over to Zoram'gar Outpost on the coast of the Zoram Strand; show Je'neu Sancrea what you found. If anyone can figure out that globe's significance, it'd be him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, hello there. I spend a great deal of time studying the water - all the elements really - so much so that sometimes I don't even notice people around me.
Is there something I can help you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This globe... It is most disturbing. Many of the more powerful elementals receive their power and energy through such devices. To find one like this nearly intact is one thing - to find it so tainted is another.

I will see that this globe is studied properly by the Earthen Ring. Perhaps we can bring an end to this corruption of the elements. Please - accept this as a fair exchange for bringing this globe to the attention of the Earthen Ring.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
